value.rationale: Hill 17 is the unique natural integer Hill exponent where the established quadratic mean response vanishes at the Hopf point, so the sign and size of the first surviving mean displacement are meaningful, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The two competing fourth-order terms have opposite signs; their explicit positive difference resolves the otherwise ambiguous biochemical-output bias.
